点.meaning: measure word for small round things; (point, dot)

example.zh: 现在几点？
example.py: Xiànzài jǐ diǎn?
example.en: What time is it now?

点.meaning: to light, to ignite; (point, dot; to order)

example.zh: 我们八点见。
example.py: Wǒmen bā diǎn jiàn.
example.en: Let's meet at eight o'clock.

example.zh: 已经十点了，他还在工作。
example.py: Yǐjīng shí diǎn le, tā hái zài gōngzuò.
example.en: It is already ten o'clock, but he is still working.

example.zh: 我从图书馆借了一本书，明天要去还书。
example.py: Wǒ cóng túshūguǎn jiè le yì běn shū, míngtiān yào qù huán shū.
example.en: I borrowed a book from the library and need to return it tomorrow.

example.zh: 你好，很高兴认识你！
example.py: Nǐ hǎo, hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ!
example.en: Hello, nice to meet you!

好.meaning: to like, to be fond of

example.zh: 这道题有些难，不好做。
example.py: zhè dào tí yǒu xiē nán ， bù hǎo zuò 。
example.en: This question is a bit difficult and not easy to answer.

example.zh: 你会说英语吗？
example.py: Nǐ huì shuō Yīngyǔ ma?
example.en: Can you speak English?

example.zh: 明天我们开会。
example.py: Míngtiān wǒmen kāihuì.
example.en: We have a meeting tomorrow.

看.meaning: to see, to look at, to read, to watch

example.zh: 我喜欢在家里看书。
example.py: Wǒ xǐhuan zài jiālǐ kàn shū.
example.en: I like reading books at home.

example.zh: 妈妈生病了，妹妹在家看她。
example.py: Māma shēngbìng le, mèimei zài jiā kān tā.
example.en: Mom is sick; my younger sister is at home looking after her.

example.zh: 我有两个姐姐。
example.py: Wǒ yǒu liǎng gè jiějie.
example.en: I have two older sisters.

两.meaning: measure word for vehicles, animals, etc.

example.zh: 他有两个哥哥。
example.py: tā yǒu liǎng gè gē gē 。
example.en: He has two older brothers.

喂.meaning: hello used when answering the phone)

example.zh: 喂，请问你是谁？
example.py: Wéi, qǐngwèn nǐ shì shéi?
example.en: Hello, may I ask who you are?

example.zh: 他给羊喂了一些草料。
example.py: tā gěi yáng wèi liǎo yī xiē cǎo liào 。
example.en: He fed the sheep some hay.

只.meaning: measure word for animals, one of a pair

example.zh: 树上有一只小鸟。
example.py: Shù shàng yǒu yì zhī xiǎoniǎo.
example.en: There is a little bird in the tree.

example.zh: 我只有一个哥哥，没有姐姐。
example.py: Wǒ zhǐ yǒu yí gè gēge, méiyǒu jiějie.
example.en: I only have one older brother; I do not have an older sister.

example.zh: 啊，你来了！
example.py: Ā, nǐ lái le!
example.en: Ah, you came!

example.zh: 你来了啊！
example.py: nǐ lái liǎo ā ！
example.en: You've arrived!

example.zh: 别说话。
example.py: Bié shuōhuà.
example.en: Don't talk.

example.zh: 这件事你别管了。
example.py: zhè jiàn shì nǐ bié guǎn liǎo 。
example.en: You don't need to worry about this.

example.zh: 这条路很长，我们坐出租车去吧。
example.py: Zhè tiáo lù hěn cháng, wǒmen zuò chūzūchē qù ba.
example.en: This road is very long; let's go by taxi.

example.zh: 他的头发长得很快。
example.py: Tā de tóufa zhǎng de hěn kuài.
example.en: His hair grows very fast.

地.meaning: particle modifying an adjective into an adverb

example.zh: 妹妹高兴地笑了。
example.py: Mèimei gāoxìng de xiào le.
example.en: Younger sister smiled happily.

example.zh: 地上有很多水，走路请小心。
example.py: Dì shàng yǒu hěnduō shuǐ, zǒulù qǐng xiǎoxīn.
example.en: There is a lot of water on the ground; please be careful walking.

example.zh: 他说汉语说得很好。
example.py: Tā shuō hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.
example.en: He speaks Chinese very well.

example.zh: 他在这次汉语比赛中得了第一名。
example.py: Tā zài zhè cì hànyǔ bǐsài zhōng dé le dì-yī míng.
example.en: He won first place in this Chinese competition.

example.zh: 时间不早了，我得回家了。
example.py: Shíjiān bù zǎo le, wǒ děi huí jiā le.
example.en: It is getting late; I must go home.

example.zh: 请等我一下。
example.py: Qǐng děng wǒ yíxià.
example.en: Please wait for me a moment.

等.meaning: and so on, etc.; (class, grade; measure word)

example.zh: 请在这里等一下。
example.py: qǐng zài zhè lǐ děng yī xià 。
example.en: Please wait here.

example.zh: 过马路的时候要看车，注意安全。
example.py: Guò mǎlù de shíhou yào kàn chē, zhùyì ānquán.
example.en: When crossing the street, watch for cars and pay attention to safety.

example.zh: 我去过中国，吃过北京烤鸭。
example.py: Wǒ qùguo Zhōngguó, chīguo Běijīng kǎoyā.
example.en: I have been to China and eaten Peking duck.

example.zh: 过去我住在上海。
example.py: Guòqù wǒ zhù zài Shànghǎi.
example.en: In the past I lived in Shanghai.

example.zh: 过去这里是农村。
example.py: Guòqù zhèlǐ shì nóngcūn.
example.en: In the past, this place was a village.

example.zh: 我花了很多钱。
example.py: Wǒ huā le hěn duō qián.
example.en: I spent a lot of money.

example.zh: 桌子上有很多花。
example.py: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu hěn duō huā.
example.en: There are many flowers on the table.

example.zh: 我的头有点儿疼。
example.py: Wǒ de tóu yǒudiǎnr téng.
example.en: My head hurts a little.

example.zh: 他抬起头，看了看天上的星星。
example.py: tā tái qǐ tóu ， kàn liǎo kàn tiān shàng de xīng xīng 。
example.en: He looked up at the stars in the sky.

example.zh: 请站起来。
example.py: Qǐng zhàn qǐlái.
example.en: Please stand up.

example.zh: 请在这里站一下。
example.py: Qǐng zài zhèlǐ zhàn yíxià.
example.en: Please stand here for a moment.

着.meaning: particle indicating ongoing action or state

example.zh: 门开着，请进吧。
example.py: Mén kāi zhe, qǐng jìn ba.
example.en: The door is open; please come in.

着.meaning: to touch, to get to, to catch (fire)

example.zh: 昨天晚上我喝了咖啡，很晚才睡着。
example.py: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ hē le kāfēi, hěn wǎn cái shuìzháo.
example.en: I drank coffee last night and fell asleep very late.

example.zh: 他昨天才回来。
example.py: Tā zuótiān cái huílái.
example.en: He only came back yesterday.

example.zh: 他才来了两天。
example.py: tā cái lái liǎo liǎng tiān 。
example.en: He's only been here for two days.

example.zh: 这个地方很漂亮，我想再去一次。
example.py: Zhège dìfang hěn piàoliang, wǒ xiǎng zài qù yí cì.
example.en: This place is very beautiful; I want to go again.

example.zh: 这个地方曾经荒废多年,如今被改造成公共艺术空间。
example.py: Zhège dìfāng céngjīng huāngfèi duō nián, rújīn bèi gǎizào chéng gōnggòng yìshù kōngjiān.
example.en: This place was abandoned for many years and has now been transformed into a public art space.

example.zh: 你在干什么？
example.py: Nǐ zài gàn shénme?
example.en: What are you doing?

example.zh: 他每天努力干活。
example.py: tā měi tiān nǔ lì gān huó 。
example.en: He works hard every day.

example.zh: 爸爸每天努力工作，为了让我们生活得更好。
example.py: Bàba měitiān nǔlì gōngzuò, wèile ràng wǒmen shēnghuó de gèng hǎo.
example.en: Dad works hard every day to make our lives better.

为.meaning: to do, to act, to serve as

example.zh: 他为公司做出了贡献。
example.py: tā wéi gōng sī zuò chū liǎo gòng xiàn 。
example.en: He made contributions to the company.

example.zh: 他为这个公益项目贡献了很多时间。
example.py: tā wéi zhè gè gōng yì xiàng mù gòng xiàn liǎo hěn duō shí jiān 。
example.en: He dedicated a lot of time to this charity project.

example.zh: 我们明天下午三点见面，行吗？
example.py: Wǒmen míngtiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn jiànmiàn, xíng ma?
example.en: We meet tomorrow afternoon at three o'clock, is that okay?

行.meaning: line, row; measure word for lines

example.zh: 他在银行工作，这个行业待遇很好。
example.py: tā zài yín xíng gōng zuò ， zhè gè xíng yè dài yù hěn hǎo 。
example.en: He works in a bank, an industry with good pay.

example.zh: 我们中间有三个人是老师。
example.py: Wǒmen zhōngjiān yǒu sān gè rén shì lǎoshī.
example.en: Among us, three people are teachers.

中.meaning: to hit, to be hit by

example.zh: 这支箭正好中了靶心,赢得了全场掌声。
example.py: Zhè zhī jiàn zhènghǎo zhòng le bǎxīn, yíngdé le quánchǎng zhǎngshēng.
example.en: This arrow hit the bullseye exactly and won applause from the whole audience.

example.zh: 这家超市里有许多种新鲜的水果。
example.py: Zhè jiā chāoshì lǐ yǒu xǔduō zhǒng xīnxiān de shuǐguǒ.
example.en: There are many kinds of fresh fruit in this supermarket.

example.zh: 爷爷在院子里种了很多漂亮的花。
example.py: Yéye zài yuànzi lǐ zhòng le hěnduō piàoliang de huā.
example.en: Grandpa planted many beautiful flowers in the yard.

example.zh: 他背着一个大书包。
example.py: tā bèi zhuó yī gè dà shū bāo 。
example.en: He was carrying a large backpack.

背.meaning: back, the back of the body; to carry on the back, to bear, to recite from memory; out-of-the-way, remote

example.zh: 他把课本背在身上。
example.py: tā bǎ kè běn bèi zài shēn shàng 。
example.en: He carried his textbooks on his back.

example.zh: 老师让我们把这篇作业重新做一遍。
example.py: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen bǎ zhè piān zuòyè chóngxīn zuò yí biàn.
example.en: The teacher asked us to do this homework assignment once again.

example.zh: 这个问题很重要。
example.py: zhè gè wèn tí hěn zhòng yào 。
example.en: This is a very important question.

example.zh: 他在家待了一周。
example.py: tā zài jiā dài liǎo yī zhōu 。
example.en: He stayed at home for a week.

example.zh: 由于航班延误,乘客被要求待在候机区等候进一步通知。
example.py: Yóuyú hángbān yánwù, chéngkè bèi yāoqiú dài zài hòujīqū děnghòu jìnyí bù tōngzhī.
example.en: Because the flight was delayed, passengers were asked to stay in the waiting area for further notice.

当.meaning: to serve as, to be; at the time of

example.zh: 当老师是他的梦想。
example.py: dāng lǎo shī shì tā de mèng xiǎng 。
example.en: Being a teacher was his dream.

当.meaning: to treat as, to regard as; to serve as

example.zh: 当他说完，大家都鼓起掌来。
example.py: dāng tā shuō wán ， dà jiā dū gǔ qǐ zhǎng lái 。
example.en: When he finished speaking, everyone applauded.

example.zh: 他把水倒进杯子里。
example.py: tā bǎ shuǐ dǎo jìn bēi zǐ lǐ 。
example.en: He poured the water into the cup.

example.zh: 他不小心把水杯倒了。
example.py: tā bù xiǎo xīn bǎ shuǐ bēi dǎo liǎo 。
example.en: He accidentally spilled the water glass.

空.meaning: empty, vacant, hollow; （in vain, for nothing）

example.zh: 今天天气很好，蓝蓝的天空上没有一朵云。
example.py: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, lánlán de tiānkōng shàng méiyǒu yì duǒ yún.
example.en: The weather is great today; there is not a single cloud in the blue sky.

空.meaning: to leave empty, to make time, to free up; empty, free, unoccupied; free time, empty space

example.zh: 天空很蓝。
example.py: tiān kōng hěn lán 。
example.en: The sky is very blue.

example.zh: 医生给病人量了体温，发现他发烧了。
example.py: Yīshēng gěi bìngrén liáng le tǐwēn, fāxiàn tā fāshāo le.
example.en: The doctor measured the patient's temperature and found that he had a fever.

example.zh: 这瓶水的量是五百毫升。
example.py: zhè píng shuǐ de liáng shì wǔ bǎi háo shēng 。
example.en: The volume of this bottle of water is 500 milliliters.

落.meaning: to fall, to drop, to land

example.zh: 秋天到了，树叶慢慢地落了下来。
example.py: Qiūtiān dào le, shùyè mànman de luò le xiàlai.
example.en: Autumn has arrived, and leaves slowly fell down.

落.meaning: to leave behind, to lag behind

example.zh: 他出门太急,把钥匙落在办公室了。
example.py: Tā chūmén tài jí, bǎ yàoshi là zài bàngōngshì le.
example.en: He left his keys in the office because he went out in too much of a hurry.

example.zh: 出门坐公交可以省钱。
example.py: chū mén zuò gōng jiāo kě yǐ shěng qián 。
example.en: Taking the bus can save you money.

example.zh: 他在工作中注意节省时间和资源。
example.py: tā zài gōng zuò zhōng zhù yì jié shěng shí jiān hé zī yuán 。
example.en: He is mindful of saving time and resources in his work.

example.zh: 他的数学成绩非常好，经常考一百分。
example.py: Tā de shùxué chéngjì fēicháng hǎo, jīngcháng kǎo yībǎi fēn.
example.en: His math grades are very good; he often scores 100 points.

example.zh: 这道题的数目非常大，需要仔细计算。
example.py: zhè dào tí de shù mù fēi cháng dà ， xū yào zī xì jì suàn 。
example.en: The number of problems is very large and requires careful calculation.

转.meaning: to turn, to shift, to transfer

example.zh: 请在路口向左转。
example.py: qǐng zài lù kǒu xiàng zuǒ zhuǎn 。
example.en: Please turn left at the intersection.

example.zh: 风扇一直在转,房间里的空气终于流动起来。
example.py: Fēngshàn yìzhí zài zhuàn, fángjiān lǐ de kōngqì zhōngyú liúdòng qǐlai.
example.en: The fan kept turning, and the air in the room finally began to move.

冲.meaning: to rush, to rinse, to pour

example.zh: 水冲走了路上的泥土。
example.py: shuǐ chōng zǒu liǎo lù shàng de ní tǔ 。
example.en: The water washed away the mud on the road.

example.zh: 他冲我笑了笑,似乎是在暗示会议已经结束。
example.py: Tā chòng wǒ xiào le xiào, sìhū shì zài ànshì huìyì yǐjīng jiéshù.
example.en: He smiled at me, as if hinting that the meeting was already over.

example.zh: 这个问题很难处。
example.py: zhè gè wèn tí hěn nán chǔ 。
example.en: This is a difficult problem to solve.

example.zh: 他被安排在一个特殊的处。
example.py: tā bèi ān pái zài yī gè tè shū de chǔ 。
example.en: He was assigned to a special department.

example.zh: 老师调整了课程的安排。
example.py: lǎo shī diào zhěng liǎo kè chéng de ān pái 。
example.en: The teacher adjusted the course schedule.

example.zh: 他们对这道题目进行了一次讨论和调整。
example.py: tā mén duì zhè dào tí mù jìn xíng liǎo yī cì tǎo lùn hé diào zhěng 。
example.en: They discussed and adjusted the question.

example.zh: 他在地图上划出了路线。
example.py: tā zài dì tú shàng huá chū liǎo lù xiàn 。
example.en: He drew the route on the map.

example.zh: 船夫用力划着小船,把游客送到对岸的村庄。
example.py: Chuánfū yònglì huá zhe xiǎochuán, bǎ yóukè sòng dào duì'àn de cūnzhuāng.
example.en: The boatman rowed the small boat with effort, taking the tourists to the village on the opposite bank.

example.zh: 他帮孩子系好了安全带。
example.py: tā bāng hái zǐ xì hǎo liǎo ān quán dài 。
example.en: He helped the child fasten his seatbelt.

example.zh: 他把两个系统连接了起来。
example.py: tā bǎ liǎng gè xì tǒng lián jiē liǎo qǐ lái 。
example.en: He connected the two systems.

example.zh: 秋天到了，树叶开始结果了。
example.py: qiū tiān dào liǎo ， shù yè kāi shǐ jié guǒ liǎo 。
example.en: Autumn has arrived, and the leaves are beginning to bear fruit.

example.zh: 这棵苹果树去年没有开花,今年却结了不少果子。
example.py: Zhè kē píngguǒ shù qùnián méiyǒu kāihuā, jīnnián què jiē le bù shǎo guǒzi.
example.en: This apple tree did not blossom last year, but this year it has borne quite a lot of fruit.

example.zh: 她用扇子扇了扇风，感觉凉快多了。
example.py: tā yòng shàn zǐ shàn liǎo shàn fēng ， gǎn jué liáng kuài duō liǎo 。
example.en: She fanned herself with a fan and felt much cooler.

example.zh: 这扇窗户朝南,清晨阳光能直接照进来。
example.py: Zhè shàn chuānghu cháo nán, qīngchén yángguāng néng zhíjiē zhào jìnlai.
example.en: This window faces south, so morning sunlight can shine directly in.

example.zh: 厨师把鸡腿放进油锅里炸。
example.py: chú shī bǎ jī tuǐ fàng jìn yóu guō lǐ zhà 。
example.en: The chef put the chicken legs into the oil to fry.

example.zh: 突然传来的巨响,让大家以为附近有东西炸了。
example.py: Tūrán chuán lái de jùxiǎng, ràng dàjiā yǐwéi fùjìn yǒu dōngxi zhà le.
example.en: The sudden loud noise made everyone think that something nearby had exploded.

卷.meaning: to roll, to curl; roll; measure word for rolls

example.zh: 她把海报卷起来,放进纸筒里带走。
example.py: Tā bǎ hǎibào juǎn qǐlái, fàng jìn zhǐtǒng lǐ dài zǒu.
example.en: She rolled up the poster and put it into a paper tube to take away.

example.zh: 这套小说一共有三卷,内容围绕同一个家族展开。
example.py: Zhè tào xiǎoshuō yí gòng yǒu sān juàn, nèiróng wéirào tóng yí gè jiāzú zhǎnkāi.
example.en: This set of novels has three volumes in total, with the content centred on the same family.

example.zh: 他把零钱散在桌上,仔细数了一遍。
example.py: Tā bǎ língqián sǎn zài zhuō shàng, zǐxì shǔ le yí biàn.
example.en: He scattered the small change on the table and counted it carefully.

example.zh: 会议结束后,人群很快散了,广场恢复了平静。
example.py: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, rénqún hěn kuài sàn le, guǎngchǎng huīfù le píngjìng.
example.en: After the meeting ended, the crowd quickly dispersed and the square became calm again.

example.zh: 在公共场所随地吐口水既不卫生,也很不礼貌。
example.py: Zài gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ suídì tǔ kǒushuǐ jì bù wèishēng, yě hěn bù lǐmào.
example.en: Spitting in public places is both unhygienic and very impolite.

example.zh: 他晕车很严重,刚下车就吐了。
example.py: Tā yùnchē hěn yánzhòng, gāng xià chē jiù tù le.
example.en: He gets carsick badly and vomited as soon as he got out of the car.

看.meaning: to see, to look at, to read, to watch

example.zh: 我喜欢在家里看书。
example.py: Wǒ xǐhuan zài jiālǐ kàn shū.
example.en: I like reading books at home.

example.zh: 妈妈生病了，妹妹在家看她。
example.py: Māma shēngbìng le, mèimei zài jiā kān tā.
example.en: Mom is sick; my younger sister is at home looking after her.

example.zh: 这条路很长，我们坐出租车去吧。
example.py: Zhè tiáo lù hěn cháng, wǒmen zuò chūzūchē qù ba.
example.en: This road is very long; let's go by taxi.

example.zh: 他的头发长得很快。
example.py: Tā de tóufa zhǎng de hěn kuài.
example.en: His hair grows very fast.

地.meaning: particle modifying an adjective into an adverb

example.zh: 妹妹高兴地笑了。
example.py: Mèimei gāoxìng de xiào le.
example.en: Younger sister smiled happily.

example.zh: 地上有很多水，走路请小心。
example.py: Dì shàng yǒu hěnduō shuǐ, zǒulù qǐng xiǎoxīn.
example.en: There is a lot of water on the ground; please be careful walking.

example.zh: 他说汉语说得很好。
example.py: Tā shuō hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.
example.en: He speaks Chinese very well.

example.zh: 他在这次汉语比赛中得了第一名。
example.py: Tā zài zhè cì hànyǔ bǐsài zhōng dé le dì-yī míng.
example.en: He won first place in this Chinese competition.

example.zh: 时间不早了，我得回家了。
example.py: Shíjiān bù zǎo le, wǒ děi huí jiā le.
example.en: It is getting late; I must go home.

example.zh: 过马路的时候要看车，注意安全。
example.py: Guò mǎlù de shíhou yào kàn chē, zhùyì ānquán.
example.en: When crossing the street, watch for cars and pay attention to safety.

example.zh: 我去过中国，吃过北京烤鸭。
example.py: Wǒ qùguo Zhōngguó, chīguo Běijīng kǎoyā.
example.en: I have been to China and eaten Peking duck.

example.zh: 已经十点了，他还在工作。
example.py: Yǐjīng shí diǎn le, tā hái zài gōngzuò.
example.en: It is already ten o'clock, but he is still working.

example.zh: 我从图书馆借了一本书，明天要去还书。
example.py: Wǒ cóng túshūguǎn jiè le yì běn shū, míngtiān yào qù huán shū.
example.en: I borrowed a book from the library and need to return it tomorrow.

只.meaning: measure word for animals, one of a pair

example.zh: 树上有一只小鸟。
example.py: Shù shàng yǒu yì zhī xiǎoniǎo.
example.en: There is a little bird in the tree.

example.zh: 我只有一个哥哥，没有姐姐。
example.py: Wǒ zhǐ yǒu yí gè gēge, méiyǒu jiějie.
example.en: I only have one older brother; I do not have an older sister.

example.zh: 我们明天下午三点见面，行吗？
example.py: Wǒmen míngtiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn jiànmiàn, xíng ma?
example.en: We meet tomorrow afternoon at three o'clock, is that okay?

行.meaning: line, row; measure word for lines

example.zh: 他在银行工作，这个行业待遇很好。
example.py: tā zài yín xíng gōng zuò ， zhè gè xíng yè dài yù hěn hǎo 。
example.en: He works in a bank, an industry with good pay.

当.meaning: to serve as, to be; at the time of

example.zh: 当老师是他的梦想。
example.py: dāng lǎo shī shì tā de mèng xiǎng 。
example.en: Being a teacher was his dream.

当.meaning: to treat as, to regard as; to serve as

example.zh: 当他说完，大家都鼓起掌来。
example.py: dāng tā shuō wán ， dà jiā dū gǔ qǐ zhǎng lái 。
example.en: When he finished speaking, everyone applauded.

example.zh: 他把水倒进杯子里。
example.py: tā bǎ shuǐ dǎo jìn bēi zǐ lǐ 。
example.en: He poured the water into the cup.

example.zh: 他不小心把水杯倒了。
example.py: tā bù xiǎo xīn bǎ shuǐ bēi dǎo liǎo 。
example.en: He accidentally spilled the water glass.

空.meaning: empty, vacant, hollow; （in vain, for nothing）

example.zh: 今天天气很好，蓝蓝的天空上没有一朵云。
example.py: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, lánlán de tiānkōng shàng méiyǒu yì duǒ yún.
example.en: The weather is great today; there is not a single cloud in the blue sky.

空.meaning: to leave empty, to make time, to free up; empty, free, unoccupied; free time, empty space

example.zh: 天空很蓝。
example.py: tiān kōng hěn lán 。
example.en: The sky is very blue.

example.zh: 医生给病人量了体温，发现他发烧了。
example.py: Yīshēng gěi bìngrén liáng le tǐwēn, fāxiàn tā fāshāo le.
example.en: The doctor measured the patient's temperature and found that he had a fever.

example.zh: 这瓶水的量是五百毫升。
example.py: zhè píng shuǐ de liáng shì wǔ bǎi háo shēng 。
example.en: The volume of this bottle of water is 500 milliliters.

example.zh: 他的数学成绩非常好，经常考一百分。
example.py: Tā de shùxué chéngjì fēicháng hǎo, jīngcháng kǎo yībǎi fēn.
example.en: His math grades are very good; he often scores 100 points.

example.zh: 这道题的数目非常大，需要仔细计算。
example.py: zhè dào tí de shù mù fēi cháng dà ， xū yào zī xì jì suàn 。
example.en: The number of problems is very large and requires careful calculation.

example.zh: 这个问题很重要。
example.py: zhè gè wèn tí hěn zhòng yào 。
example.en: This is a very important question.

example.zh: 老师让我们把这篇作业重新做一遍。
example.py: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen bǎ zhè piān zuòyè chóngxīn zuò yí biàn.
example.en: The teacher asked us to do this homework assignment once again.

转.meaning: to turn, to shift, to transfer

example.zh: 请在路口向左转。
example.py: qǐng zài lù kǒu xiàng zuǒ zhuǎn 。
example.en: Please turn left at the intersection.

example.zh: 风扇一直在转,房间里的空气终于流动起来。
example.py: Fēngshàn yìzhí zài zhuàn, fángjiān lǐ de kōngqì zhōngyú liúdòng qǐlai.
example.en: The fan kept turning, and the air in the room finally began to move.

example.zh: 他被安排在一个特殊的处。
example.py: tā bèi ān pái zài yī gè tè shū de chǔ 。
example.en: He was assigned to a special department.

example.zh: 这个问题很难处。
example.py: zhè gè wèn tí hěn nán chǔ 。
example.en: This is a difficult problem to solve.

example.zh: 老师调整了课程的安排。
example.py: lǎo shī diào zhěng liǎo kè chéng de ān pái 。
example.en: The teacher adjusted the course schedule.

example.zh: 他们对这道题目进行了一次讨论和调整。
example.py: tā mén duì zhè dào tí mù jìn xíng liǎo yī cì tǎo lùn hé diào zhěng 。
example.en: They discussed and adjusted the question.

example.zh: 他帮孩子系好了安全带。
example.py: tā bāng hái zǐ xì hǎo liǎo ān quán dài 。
example.en: He helped the child fasten his seatbelt.

example.zh: 他把两个系统连接了起来。
example.py: tā bǎ liǎng gè xì tǒng lián jiē liǎo qǐ lái 。
example.en: He connected the two systems.

卷.meaning: to roll, to curl; roll; measure word for rolls

example.zh: 她把海报卷起来,放进纸筒里带走。
example.py: Tā bǎ hǎibào juǎn qǐlái, fàng jìn zhǐtǒng lǐ dài zǒu.
example.en: She rolled up the poster and put it into a paper tube to take away.

example.zh: 这套小说一共有三卷,内容围绕同一个家族展开。
example.py: Zhè tào xiǎoshuō yí gòng yǒu sān juàn, nèiróng wéirào tóng yí gè jiāzú zhǎnkāi.
example.en: This set of novels has three volumes in total, with the content centred on the same family.

example.zh: 在公共场所随地吐口水既不卫生,也很不礼貌。
example.py: Zài gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ suídì tǔ kǒushuǐ jì bù wèishēng, yě hěn bù lǐmào.
example.en: Spitting in public places is both unhygienic and very impolite.

example.zh: 他晕车很严重,刚下车就吐了。
example.py: Tā yùnchē hěn yánzhòng, gāng xià chē jiù tù le.
example.en: He gets carsick badly and vomited as soon as he got out of the car.

example.zh: 他把零钱散在桌上,仔细数了一遍。
example.py: Tā bǎ língqián sǎn zài zhuō shàng, zǐxì shǔ le yí biàn.
example.en: He scattered the small change on the table and counted it carefully.

example.zh: 会议结束后,人群很快散了,广场恢复了平静。
example.py: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, rénqún hěn kuài sàn le, guǎngchǎng huīfù le píngjìng.
example.en: After the meeting ended, the crowd quickly dispersed and the square became calm again.
